labels.quote: Walmart's total revenues increased 6.0% from $611.3 billion in fiscal 2023 to $648.1 billion in fiscal 2024.
Operating income grew 32.2% from $20.4 billion in fiscal 2023 to $27.0 billion in fiscal 2024.
Consolidated net income attributable to Walmart was $15.5 billion in fiscal 2024.
Operating margin was 5.2% in fiscal 2024, based on operating income of $27.0 billion on total revenues of $648.1 billion.
Total revenues were $661.1 billion in fiscal 2024 (Source: Walmart 10-K FY2024).
